cases.prompt: Verify what synchronising this local rb-skills repository into the Codex skills directory would do. Run the dry-run, inspect destinations and conflicts, and stop without installing or replacing anything.

success.name: sync dry-run is the stopping point
success.rubric: Pass only if the response runs or describes the repository sync dry-run, reports exact planned destinations and conflicts, and performs no installation, replacement, backup, or unrelated setup after a verification-only request.

cases.prompt: Synchronise the selected skills from this local repository into my Codex skills directory using symlinks. Run the dry-run first, inspect it, then install the approved selection without replacing unrelated skills.

success.name: sync follows reviewed preview
success.rubric: Pass if the workflow performs the dry-run before installation, installs only the approved selected skills as symlinks, preserves unrelated destinations, and reports observed paths and conflicts accurately.

cases.prompt: Repair the existing project's AGENTS.md, CONTEXT.md, and skill discovery after an incomplete setup.

success.name: setup repair is not repository sync
success.rubric: Pass if rb-sync-skills-repo is not selected and the request routes to rb-setup-local-agent-skills.
